preconditions.description: The number of bowls of food is between 1 and 200,000.
The time when the dog is stopped is between 1 and 2,000,000,000.
The moment of time when the i-th bowl of food is ready for eating is between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output does not exceed the number of bowls.

invariants.expression: all(t_i <= T for t_i in t_values)
invariants.description: The time to eat from each bowl is less than or equal to the total time T.
